questions.questionText: Which statement describes how a flame test is done?

options.text: The tip of a clean wire is dipped into the substance and the wire is placed in a blue Bunsen burner flame.
The tip of a clean wire is dipped into the substance and the wire is placed in a yellow Bunsen burner flame.
A wooden splint is lit and is placed above a test-tube containing the gas being tested.

A wooden splint is lit, blown out and the glowing splint put into a test-tube of the gas being tested.
